build_SLSTM_layer: build a PyTorch SLSTM layer with a given feature dimension and number of layers
create_SLSTM_with_skip: create an SLSTM module with skip connections enabled for convolutional layout input
create_SLSTM_without_skip: create an SLSTM module with skip connections disabled for convolutional layout input
run_SLSTM_forward: run forward pass through an SLSTM layer on a convolutional layout tensor
review_SLSTM_permute: review the SLSTM forward method that permutes data between convolutional and LSTM layouts
